# Portfolio content instructions

- Preserve accurate attribution. Distinguish work Julia built, led, co-led,
  supported, or contributed to as a team outcome.
- Keep public artifacts, retrospective case studies, and independent
  demonstrations clearly distinct.
- Use only supported facts. Do not add unsupported metrics, dates,
  implementation details, adoption claims, or causal claims.
- Do not include private corporate material, internal identifiers, customer
  records, confidential discussions, source code, prompts, or unpublished
  guidance.
- Label fictional or newly created demonstrations prominently and never
  present them as employer artifacts.
- Check external links when changing published-work references and preserve
  useful existing content.
- Prefer a narrower accurate statement or omission over speculation.
